metrics.name: Booking provisioning (payment -> booking)
metrics.description: Of successful booking-fee payments, what share have a matching booking-fee-captured record against that same transaction?

metrics.name: Address Submitted -> Booking Confirmed (10min) %
metrics.description: Of customers who submitted an address (address_updated event) -- counting only their first submission, or their first since a prior booking was cancelled (cancelled event) -- what share had their booking confirmed (booking_confirmed event) within 10 minutes AFTER it? Address to confirm is a synchronous step (median 0 minutes, 95-99% inside 1 minute), so the window is tight and forward-only. A submission is counted once it has itself completed 10 minutes.

metrics.name: Install TRUM plan creation within 30 mins
metrics.description: Of installs that reached the AWAITING_CUSTOMER_OTP state, what share had their TRUM plan created within 30 minutes of reaching it?

metrics.name: Device live at install (ping within 30 min)
metrics.description: Of installs that reached the AWAITING_CUSTOMER_OTP state, what share had the device show ping activity within 30 minutes after reaching it, or in the 10 minutes just before?

metrics.name: Technician assigned msg to customer
metrics.description: Of technician assignments (rohit_assigned event), what share had the customer notified over chat within 10 minutes?

metrics.name: Recharge to device live within 2h (non-queued only)
metrics.description: Of recharges that follow a genuine offline period (paid >=15 min after the prior plan's expiry, or the first-ever plan on that device), what share had the device show ping activity within 2 hours? Excludes queued recharges (paid before the prior plan expired), since those never take the router offline and don't test recovery behaviour.

metrics.name: Renewal provisioning (payment -> plan & entitlement)
metrics.description: Of successful renewal payments, what share had a matching plan and entitlement created against that same transaction?

metrics.name: Customer plan ISP coverage (paid-hour level)
metrics.description: Of every hour a customer's plan is active and paid for, what share actually had ISP access enabled (gate open)?

metrics.name: Customers NOT affected rate (100 - % customers affected)
metrics.description: Of paying customers, what share had zero hours where their ISP access gate was closed?

metrics.name: Captive Portal triggered -> open (user level)
metrics.description: Of customers (unique NAS) whose captive portal was triggered on the day, what share had EVERY trigger followed by a portal open within 5 minutes? Strict rule: a customer with even one unserved trigger counts as one defaulter, even if their other triggers opened (5 triggers / 0 opens = 1 defaulter, not 5; 2 triggers / 1 open = still a defaulter). Grain changed from event level to user level 31-Aug-2026.

metrics.name: Recharge Ticket Creation Rate (System Health)
metrics.description: For every hour a customer had already paid for (excluding their first 30 days post-install), does a recharge ticket's [created_at, obligation_window_end) window span that hour? Connections currently DEACTIVATED or PENDING_DEACTIVATION are excluded. Measures ticket creation and system-tracked obligation coverage only, not partner claim speed or resolution time. Only D-1..D-3 are computed; W-1..M-3 are not available for this metric.

metrics.name: Renewal Reminder - R0 (sent within 24h before expiry)
metrics.description: Of plan expiries where the customer hadn't already recharged early (or renewed with zero gap), what share had the R0 renewal reminder sent within 24 hours before expiry?

metrics.name: % Refund Requested (PAYG migrated)
metrics.description: Of pickup tickets for PAYG MIGRATED customers (first valid TRUM row before 2026-01-26, computed from install date, never migration flags), what share have a security-deposit refund order created? Migrated customers had no SDO construct at onboarding but still get a refund order on pickup. Split from the blended PAYG metric 18-Sep-2026.

metrics.name: % Refund Requested (PAYG installed, SD>0)
metrics.description: Of pickup tickets for PAYG INSTALLED customers (first valid TRUM row on/after 2026-01-26) who paid a non-zero security deposit (CUSTOMER_V_2.SD_AMOUNT > 0), what share have an SDO created? Zero-SD installs get no SDO by design and are excluded from the denominator. Split from the blended PAYG metric 18-Sep-2026. Thin denominator (~40/day).

metrics.name: % Refund Processed (PAYG)
metrics.description: Of completed pickup tickets (excluding cases where the router was returned but no UPI was submitted), what share have their refund order in PROCESSING or SUCCESSFUL status?

metrics.name: Refund Orders stuck 5+ days in Processing (PAYG)
metrics.description: How many PAYG refund orders are currently in PROCESSING status and have already been there 5+ days? Shown as a count, not a percentage -- target is zero.

metrics.name: Chat input to output within 1 min
metrics.description: Of customer chat messages, what share receive one within 60 seconds, excluding messages that are never meant to get a reply?

metrics.name: New ticket via chat -> created in ticket system within 5min
metrics.description: When the chat bot tells a customer a new complaint ticket has been created (complaint_ticket_type_3_or_4_created), does that ticket actually exist in the correct backend within 5 minutes? Routed by the customer's own partner's migration status at the time of the ticket: migrated partners are checked against the new CSP complaints system, not-yet-migrated partners against the old STM system.

metrics.name: Reopened ticket via chat -> reopened in ticket system within 5min
metrics.description: When the chat bot tells a customer their ticket has been reopened (complaint_resolved_ticket_reopened workflow), what share actually show as reopened in the ticket system within 5 minutes of that message?

metrics.name: Booking not-installed-14D -> resolved-by-16D
metrics.description: Of bookings still unresolved at day 14 (neither installed nor cancelled), what share reached closure by day 16 by any means, cancellation or install? Sourced from booking_logs event history. Only bookings that have had a full 16 days elapse are scored.

metrics.name: Renewal payment funnel (in-app, 5-minute chain)
metrics.description: Of recharge-CTA clicks, how far the customer got in one sitting. Each step must follow the previous within 5 minutes. An attempt is a CTA click more than 30 minutes after that customer's previous one.
metrics.note: Three of these events start 17 Aug 2026, so earlier windows are blank. Payment summary and checkout read 100% by construction — those pages always load after their click.

metrics.name: BFP -> Installed within 3 days
metrics.description: Fee paid → installed within 3 days. Goal metric.

metrics.name: Step 1: BFP -> address submitted
metrics.description: Fee paid → address submitted.

metrics.name: Step 2: address -> technician assigned
metrics.description: Address submitted → technician assigned.

metrics.name: Step 3: technician assigned -> arrived
metrics.description: Technician assigned → technician arrived.

metrics.name: Step 4: technician arrived -> installed
metrics.description: Technician arrived → installed.

metrics.name: BFP -> Installed within 5 days
metrics.description: Fee paid → installed within 5 days.

metrics.name: Reach around expiry — app opens and recharge intent
metrics.description: Of plan expiries, the share who opened the app or revealed a plan price within the stated window either side of expiry. Counted once per expiry.
metrics.note: A cell appears once its window is matured (width + 1 days): ±24h fills every column, ±72h from D-4, ±7d from W-2. A dash means not yet measurable.

metrics.name: Renewal curve (R0 - R15)
metrics.description: Of plan expiries, the share whose next plan had started by day N after expiry. R0 means on or before the expiry moment.
metrics.note: A value marked * covers only the earlier part of the window; the rest have not had N days yet. A dash means no expiry has had N days.
